name: Cloudflare DNS
summary: Cloudflare's authoritative DNS: anycast name servers, DDoS-resilient resolution and a free, fully-featured API.
description: Product page for Cloudflare's authoritative DNS, which translates domain names into IP addresses from a global anycast network. It covers raw query performance, DDoS resiliency, API access for infrastructure-as-code, and uses such as automated certificate validation, instant propagation and internal zones.
